description: Create a filesystem and return it; its id is what tickets and mounts need. org_id is optional: an API key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. Not idempotent, and names need not be unique: after a timeout or an unknown outcome, call list_filesystems and look for the name before creating again. Never retry blindly. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.

name.description: the filesystem's name; names need not be unique

name: create_filesystem
